description: Seeded-error evals for the hcd-researcher agent (issue 120). Each case plants defects with known id, class, severity, location, and text into a copy of a base artifact; a run dispatches one review per case and the scorer checks, mechanically, which planted claims the findings list names and whether each planted p0 also produced a p0 verdict line. Classes reuse the agent's own lens words (decision trace, participant respect, evidence honesty, method fit, scope load). Severity reuses the verdict-contract p0 bar: a planted defect is p0 only when it invalidates the artifact (an unsupported core claim, or a method that cannot answer its own questions). Every planted defect is detectable from the artifact itself; no case needs a live tracker, chat, calendar, or Drive service.
how_to_run: Operator-run, never a wired gate: python tests/evals/hcd-researcher/run_evals.py prepare --run-dir <dir> copies the base artifacts, applies the planted edits mechanically, and prints the twelve dispatch prompts; dispatch each prompt to one general-purpose subagent (foreground, at most 3 in flight) and save each reply to <dir>/outputs/case-<id>.txt the moment it lands; then score with run_evals.py score --run-dir <dir> and record with run_evals.py record --run-dir <dir>. PASS requires every planted p0 caught with a p0 verdict and overall F1 at or above the recorded baseline F1.

suites.draft-spec: Base artifacts are copies of tests/fixtures/spec/uc2-spec.json and uc2-spec-with-rq3.json shapes; a location names a spec key path the applier replaces with the planted text.
suites.report: Base artifacts are small synthetic deliverables in the commands/uxr-report.md front-matter shape; a location is a substring of the line the applier replaces with the planted line.
